artifact_provenance: Pulled byte-for-byte from the installed package on the reviewed Pixel 7 after the user-confirmed session.

rebuild_finding.description: A later offline debug rebuild succeeded but produced a different APK and native ELF digest. Debug packaging is not byte-reproducible under the current toolchain, so the later build is not substituted for the exact installed artifact under test.
rebuild_finding.impact: No impact on the exact installed artifact identity or the observed functional-smoke behavior; deterministic release packaging remains successor hardening.
